newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex to seek approval for share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Telmex to seek approval for share buyback.

text.p: Telefonos de Mexico said Thursday it will seek shareholder approval at its December 10 annual meeting to start a new programme to repurchase up to an additional 800 million of its shares.

"From December 5, 1995, when Telmex decided to rebuy one billion shares, the company has repurchased about 790 million of them up until today," Gerardo Munoz, director of investor relations with the telephone company, told Reuters.
"This new proposal looks to authorise an additional programme of 800 million more and for the corresponding reserves to be made," the director said.
The 210 million outstanding from the original buyback plus the additional 800 million under the new plan equal 11 percent of the total number of Telmex shares in circulation.
The buyback, which will be done with company funds, does not involve its ADR shares.
